overall_summary: Analysis of 47 unique uploads reveals a stark performance divide: first-person hypothetical immersion shorts ('What If You Fell Into...') focusing on extreme celestial environments consistently lead the channel, generating 800 to 1,050+ views and the highest engagement rates (up to 3.7% likes-per-view). Conversely, abstract cognitive psychology trivia and repetitive reposts of basic animal/space facts stall below 100 views with near-zero engagement. Optimizing for visceral survival-scale physics between 19 and 21 seconds yields the strongest algorithmic push.

winning_patterns.pattern: First-Person Speculative Ingestion / Fall Scenarios ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos using this framing ('Liquid Diamond Planet' with 1,029 views & 38 likes; 'Burning Ice' with 972 views & 18 likes; 'Darkest Planet' with 823 views & 15 likes) average over 800 views and drive nearly all channel comments.
winning_patterns.action: Anchor scripts in immediate, second-person hypothetical journeys into extreme physical conditions rather than passive third-person encyclopedic narration.

winning_patterns.pattern: Visceral Sensory and Geological Extremes (19-21s pacing)
winning_patterns.evidence: 'Planet Darker Than Coal' (1,029 views, 36 likes, 21s) and 'Supersonic Rubies' (723 views, 25 likes, 21s) outperformed shorter 12-16s general trivia by over 500%.
winning_patterns.action: Maintain optimal narrative runtime around 19-21 seconds, pacing the reveal across 3 distinct escalations of environmental hostility.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (5 to 53 views across multiple iterations), 'Earworms' (17 views), and 'Your Brain Is Hiding This' (38 views) generated 0 comments and under 1% engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Pause text-heavy, intangible cognitive trivia until visual and narrative frameworks can ground concepts in cinematic tension.

weak_patterns.evidence: Duplicate uploads of 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' (dropped from 220 to 34 views) and 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' produce diminishing returns and audience fatigue.
weak_patterns.action: Enforce strict deduplication; always tackle unexplored entities rather than re-uploading identical hooks.
